history.overview: The Laboratory is where Muramite Inquisitors refine Discord energy into usable forms.

timeline.name: Laboratory Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves carved the initial laboratory chambers.

timeline.name: Vat Installation
timeline.description: Containment vats were installed to hold Discord energy.

timeline.name: Experimentation Era
timeline.description: Inquisitors began experimenting on Dragorn captives and Discord constructs.

timeline.name: Core Refinement
timeline.description: Discord cores were refined into ritual components.
